sub: Week 12, Plan 1: Thu 11/19 dinner to Mon 11/23 breakfast.

days.note: Pizza is ordered with the Aldi delivery, so tonight is easy.
am: Add the Aldi pizza to the delivery order (2 large pizzas) and a package of pre-made cookies.
When the groceries arrive, put the cold items away first.
pm: Serve the pizza with carrot sticks and a cookie each.
Tonight at 10 pm: assemble the egg and toast bake in the crockpot and start it on low.

days.note: Breakfast cooked itself overnight. Lunch is leftover pizza, dinner is a dump-and-go macaroni.
am: Scoop the crockpot egg bake into bowls (it should be set in the middle). Wash the crockpot.
Pack school lunches for the middle and youngest: leftover pizza, or a peanut butter or cheddar sandwich with carrot sticks.
Pack the snacks: apple slices and string cheese in the morning, carrots, ranch yogurt dip and pretzels for after school.
By 11:30 am: start the cheeseburger macaroni in the crockpot (turkey, onion, sauce and broth on low). At about 4:15 pm add the macaroni on high.
pm: About 4:15 pm: stir the macaroni into the crockpot and turn it to high (30 to 45 minutes). Stir in the evaporated milk and cheddar at the end.
Tonight at 10 pm: start the apple cinnamon oatmeal in the clean crockpot.
meals: Crockpot cheesy egg and toast bake
Carrots, ranch yogurt dip and pretzels

days.note: Oatmeal is done when you wake up. The whole chicken goes in mid-morning and cooks all day.
am: Stir the peanut butter and maple into the apple cinnamon oatmeal and top with granola. Wash the crockpot.
By 9:30 am: put the whole fresh chicken on the vegetables in the crockpot (low 7 to 8 hours). Do not use a frozen chicken.
Lunch is leftover macaroni. Set out bread and peanut butter for anyone who wants a sandwich too.
pm: After dinner: pull all the leftover chicken off the bones and refrigerate within 2 hours (about 3 cups for Sunday).
Wash the crockpot. Tonight at 10 pm: start the cheesy grits (low, overnight).
meals: Plus sandwiches if it runs short
Crockpot whole chicken with potatoes and carrots

days.note: Grits cooked overnight. Sloppy joes cook in the afternoon. Plan 2 gets approved tonight so the cart can run for Monday pickup.
am: Stir the butter and cheddar into the grits and top with banana slices. Wash the crockpot.
Make chicken sandwiches from Saturday's chicken (adult chicken salad, kid chicken and cheese). Keep about 1 1/2 cups of chicken back for Monday lunch.
About 1:00 pm: start the sloppy joes in the crockpot (low 5 to 6 hours).
pm: Tonight: look over Plan 2 and tell me it is final so the Walmart cart can be triggered for Monday pickup.
Wash the crockpot. Tonight at 10 pm: start the chocolate peanut butter oatmeal for Monday.
meals: Crockpot turkey sloppy joes with carrot sticks

days.note: Only breakfast is in this plan. Monday lunch starts Plan 2.
am: Stir the peanut butter and maple into the chocolate peanut butter oatmeal. Top with banana and chips.
Wash the crockpot. The Walmart pickup order for Plan 2 starts with Monday lunch.

b_eggbake.t: Crockpot cheesy egg and toast bake
ing: 5 slices sandwich bread, cut into cubes
1 1/2 cups cheddar, cubed or grated from a block
1 tbsp olive oil for greasing the crockpot
st: Rub the crockpot with the olive oil.
Layer the bread cubes and cheddar in the crockpot.
Whisk the eggs, milk, salt and pepper and pour over. Press the bread down.
Cook on low 5 to 6 hours overnight, until set in the middle. Start it about 10 pm so it is done by 5 or 6 am.
Scoop into bowls with a mandarin or sliced banana on the side.
Pack or plate as listed.

l_chicken.t: Chicken sandwiches (adults chicken salad, kid chicken and cheese)
ing: 3 cups cooked chicken, shredded (leftover from dinner)
6 slices cheddar, cut from a block (kid sandwiches)
Carrot sticks, about 5 baby carrots per person
st: Adults: mix 1 1/2 cups chicken with the mayo, mustard and salt and make 2 or 3 sandwiches.
Kids: layer the other 1 1/2 cups chicken and a slice of cheddar on bread, plain or with a little mayo.
Serve with the carrot sticks.

s_carrot_pretzel.t: Carrots, ranch yogurt dip and pretzels
ing: 2 tbsp plain Greek yogurt stirred with a pinch of ranch seasoning
6 pretzel twists or a small handful
st: Stir the ranch seasoning into the yogurt. Pack or plate as listed.

ing: Granola for topping, about 2 tbsp per person
st: Grease the crockpot lightly. Add the oats, water, milk, apples, cinnamon, nutmeg, vanilla and salt.
Cook on low 7 to 8 hours overnight.
In the morning stir in the peanut butter and maple until melted in. Add a splash of milk if it is thick.
Top each bowl with granola.
Pack or plate as listed.
Slice the banana and serve with the peanut butter for dipping.

d_chicken.t: Crockpot whole chicken with potatoes and carrots
ing: 1 whole fresh chicken, 4 to 5 lb (not frozen)
st: Put the onion, potatoes and carrots in the bottom of the crockpot and pour in the broth.
Rub the chicken with the olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper and set it on top, breast side up.
Cook on low 7 to 8 hours, until the thickest part of the thigh reaches 165.
Serve with the vegetables. After dinner pull all the leftover meat off the bones and refrigerate within 2 hours (about 3 cups for Sunday lunch and Monday).

ing: 1 1/2 cups stone-ground or regular grits (not instant)
1 cup cheddar, grated from a block
st: Grease the crockpot lightly. Add the grits, water, milk and salt.
Cook on low 7 to 8 hours overnight. If you forget, cook on high 2 to 3 hours in the morning and stir halfway.
Stir in the butter and cheddar until melted. Top with banana slices.
Spoon the yogurt into a cup and top with granola and a little maple.
Slice the apple and serve with the peanut butter.

d_joes.t: Crockpot turkey sloppy joes with carrot sticks
ing: Carrot sticks, about 6 baby carrots per person
st: Crumble the raw turkey into the crockpot with the onion.
Stir the tomato sauce, tomato paste, ketchup, mustard, Worcestershire, brown sugar, garlic powder and salt together and pour over.
Cook on low 5 to 6 hours or high 3. Break up the turkey with a spoon halfway and again at the end (it must reach 165).
Spoon onto the rolls and serve with the carrots.

b_chocpb.t: Crockpot chocolate peanut butter oatmeal (oats mix #3)
st: Grease the crockpot lightly. Add the oats, water, milk, cocoa, vanilla and salt and stir well (the cocoa clumps).
Cook on low 7 to 8 hours overnight.
In the morning stir in the peanut butter and maple. Loosen with a splash of milk.
Top each bowl with banana slices and a few chips.

ing: 2 large Aldi pizzas, ordered with the groceries (about 1/3 pizza per person)
st: Bake or serve as directed on the box. Serve with the carrot sticks and save the leftovers for Friday lunch.

ing: 1 pre-made cookie per person (1 package from the Aldi order)
st: Serve as is.

l_pizza.t: Leftover pizza, with sandwiches where it runs short
ing: Peanut butter or cheddar sandwiches for anyone who needs more (about 4 slices of bread, 4 slices of cheddar cut from the block)
st: Reheat the pizza. Make a peanut butter or cheddar sandwich for anyone still hungry.

ing: 1 can (12 oz) fat free evaporated milk
12 oz cheddar block, grated or cut into small cubes
st: Put the crumbled raw turkey, onion, tomato sauce, broth, ketchup, mustard, garlic powder and salt in the crockpot.
Cook on low 4 to 5 hours, breaking up the turkey once or twice. It must reach 165.
Stir in the macaroni, turn to high and cook 30 to 45 minutes, stirring once, until tender.
Stir in the evaporated milk and cheddar until melted.
Microwave the broccoli and serve alongside. Refrigerate leftovers for Saturday lunch.

l_mac.t: Leftover cheeseburger macaroni, with sandwiches where it runs short
ing: Sandwich bread, peanut butter or cheddar for anyone who needs more (about 4 slices)
st: Reheat the macaroni in the microwave. Make a peanut butter or cheddar sandwich for anyone still hungry.

dinners: Crockpot whole chicken, potatoes and carrots
Crockpot turkey sloppy joes, carrot sticks
method: Thursday is Aldi pizza. Friday to Sunday dinners and all four breakfasts are crockpot meals. Lunches are leftovers or sandwiches. Dinner is ready about 5:30 with almost no dishes. One crockpot, washed between meals.
desserts: A pre-made cookie each night, Thursday to Sunday. No desserts to make this plan.
pantry: Pantry is unknown after last week, so eyeball these before the day they are used.
Peanut butter: about 1 cup needed across the plan
Granola, grits, cocoa powder, maple syrup, mini chocolate chips
Pretzels, ranch seasoning, mayo, yellow mustard, ketchup, Worcestershire, tomato paste, brown sugar
Cinnamon, nutmeg, Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, olive oil, butter, vanilla
Fresh whole chicken only: never start a frozen one in the crockpot
Fat free evaporated milk, 1 can (12 oz) for Friday's macaroni

items: Apples, organic Honeycrisp or Pink Lady, 1 bag (3 lb)
Ground turkey, 2 lb (macaroni Friday, sloppy joes Sunday)
Plain Greek yogurt, 1 tub of 32 oz
Cheddar, 2 blocks of 16 oz (macaroni uses 12 oz, so it is tight)
Sandwich rolls or buns, 1 pack of 6 or more
Tomato sauce, 2 cans (15 oz) (macaroni Friday, sloppy joes Sunday)
Pre-made cookies, 1 package (Thu to Sun, 1 per person per night)
Granola, grits, cocoa powder, maple syrup, mini chocolate chips
Pretzels, ranch seasoning, mayo, yellow mustard, ketchup, Worcestershire
Tomato paste, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, olive oil, butter, vanilla
Fat free evaporated milk, 1 can (12 oz) for Friday's macaroni
